args.lesson: Reusing independent executed tests and completing only outstanding restoration/source checks avoided another full review loop. Initial harness checks failed because the service preview fixture had already been updated and the homepage paragraphs were compact. Reconstructing old utc() from unchanged core-a.js reproduced the original full preview hash; removing exact preview paragraphs restored the homepage byte-for-byte. Verify fixture provenance before interpreting failed assertions as product defects. Node/stub checks still do not establish browser execution or customer demand.
